item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-09-19
item.description:
1. [Tech News] Manus seeks $4B valuation in new $500M fundraise as it resumes independent ops
Manus, which earlier this year had to break off a merger with Meta, is in discussions to raise $500M at a $4B valuation.

2. [Tech News] Virginia governor creates an AI task force and moves to restrain data centers
Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger ordered the state government to take steps that could empower local communities to have a larger say in data center development and slow down approvals in a state that is already home to the data center capital of the world. Executive Order 22 ban

5. [Tech News] Businesses finally seeing AI ROI, but 62% can’t handle the storage demands
